name: deepseek-harness
tagline: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness where models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, the agent loop, and UI are all composable Cordis plugins.
sentence: An open-source agent harness by DeepSeek where every part - models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, the agent loop, and UI - is a composable Cordis plugin that can be mixed, matched, and replaced.
what_happened: **Five unpatched CVEs found Oct 16 2026.** CVE-2026-101078 (low), CVE-2026-101102 (moderate), CVE-2026-101131 (low), CVE-2026-108788 (low), CVE-2026-108789 (low). None have a patched version available.
**Previously featured in Edition 003 (Aug 14 2026).** Pulled from the site and blocklisted after the Oct 16 re-check found 5 CVEs with no fixes.
why_fail: **Five CVEs with no patched version.** The latest release is 0.2.1 and none of the five CVEs list a fix.
**One moderate-severity CVE.** CVE-2026-101102 is rated moderate. The remaining four are low severity but still unpatched.
if_used: Check the NVD entries for each CVE to understand whether they affect your use case: CVE-2026-101078, CVE-2026-101102, CVE-2026-101131, CVE-2026-108788, CVE-2026-108789.
Watch for a patched release. Once these CVEs have confirmed fixes, the gate will re-check automatically.
